title: Address
description: A ready-made name for this server, with one certificate for everything under it. It is this server's only call home: the registration and a daily check, carrying nothing else. Turn it off by releasing it here.

problem.unreachable: The last daily check did not get through. Names already issued keep working, and it tries again.
problem.lost: The service no longer knows this server, so names under this address stopped resolving. Register again to get a new one.
problem.disabled: This address was disabled by the service's operator. Register again to get a new one, or release it to use generated names.

certificateHint.issued: One certificate serves every name under this address.
certificateHint.expiring: It will be renewed by the proxy on its own.
certificateHint.expired: The proxy could not renew it. Check its logs.
certificateHint.pending: The proxy asks for it as soon as it starts, which can take a few minutes.

registerAgainDescription: This server gets a new name in place of this one, and every name under the old one moves to it. Bookmarks and links to the old names stop working.
releaseDescription: Its records are removed for good and the name is never issued again. Generated names go back to sslip.io, and this server stops calling the service.
emptyDescription: Generated names use sslip.io. Register to give this server its own name and one certificate for everything under it.
emptyDescriptionOff: This server is set to never call the address service, so generated names use sslip.io.
